original_channel_context.text:
Dear members,
We are seeing some great opportunities, 
The next pump will be:
Exchange: Binance
Date: 12-05-2018
Time 6PM GMT
Advantage: The pump will be Free-For-All (FFA)
For a live countdown, refer to our website: https://bigpumpsignal.com/ !

8 hours until the pump! 
You all have undoubtedly seen that a lot of movement is taking place. However, we feel like a pump is certainly possible, as all of this movement has opened up new opportunities. We will keep you all updated on the status of the pump throughout the day while we watch the market and its developments.
For a live countdown or if you have any questions, refer to https://bigpumpsignal.com !
6 hours left till the Binance pump
Be sure to have both the Website and Telegram open!
Next message will be the coin

Why did we pick this coin?
We wanted to try out a different strategy today in order to get more outsiders into our pump. Therefore we took a coin in which there was a lot of activity, hoping that we would pull all the outsiders in. 
As a lot of outsiders are watching and see the coin move up quickly, they will FOMO in. We have been observing this coin and saw it almost breakout a few times today. Currently, the coin is up to the exact point where a breakout is certainly possible. The last push of our combined effort can certainly achieve this!
In addition to this, we will use our contacts in order to spread the call across social media to get even more outsiders in. 
Today it's even more important than at other times to hold so outsiders can get on the train and we can all sell at a profit.

The plan was to attract outsiders by pumping a coin that was very active but had a very small supply of coins available. By buying out all the coins in an active market creates a large demand for coins. This however backfired catastrophically. It seems like there was one or more big holder of YOYO watching as the pump happened and dumped on us straight away.
We know that a lot of people speculate on our pumps and try to predict what we're doing. We can see this from the fact that ALL of the following coins got dumped exactly at the time of pumping:CDT, TRIG, RLC, ARK, ZIL, KMD, GXS, ICN
We will not be pumping on a coin like this again and the next pump will be after we reevaluate our strategy. We will be looking at what choices we can make in the future (looking at different exchanges and the like)
